mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in labor participation (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising PAYEMS, or labor participation growth decelerates below 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in GDP (GDPC1) reflects strong economic growth, which enhances corporate earnings expectations and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth slows below 3% MoM over the horizon, or 60-day returns are not statistically superior to a baseline model (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4% signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to reduced consumer spending and corporate investment, thus negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross above 4% within the next month, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p < 0.05) when the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rising GDP (GDPC1) creates a dual signal of monetary easing and robust demand, amplifying equity valuation growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 does not produce statistically significant positive returns (p > 0.05) over 60 days, or the proxies move in opposite directions during the period.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion with CPI inflation below 2%, rising CPIAUCSL (CPI) signals sustainable demand growth without overheating, prompting market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.02 in 1 month while inflation remains < 2%
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not rise above 2% in the next month, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the inflation surge.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust demand across sectors, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined effect of GDPC1 and RSAFS does not produce statistically significant positive returns (p > 0.05) over 20 days, or the proxies move inversely during the period.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with high labor participation (PAYEMS) signals robust supply-side activity and strong consumer demand, fostering market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between INDPRO and PAYEMS does not result in statistically significant positive returns (p > 0.05) over 60 days, or the proxies move inversely during the period.

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of industrial production (INDPRO) by over 1% in the next month signals robust manufacturing activity, boosting export demand and corporate margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise by >1% in the next month, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when the trigger occurs.
